The Router identified three artifacts.

2. 'Structural collapse (white tail)': Severity 1.5 is likely an underestimate. The white area looks like a single, solid, glowing polygon rather than individual feathers. It lacks the fibrous texture of plumage. I would rate this closer to 2.0-2.5 as it significantly degrades the realism of the primary display feature.
3. 'Perspective distortion (grounding)': Severity 1.0 is fair. There is minor bleeding, but the bird is mostly grounded.
